text:
mia: heads-up — heard multiple pages overnight for `infra:cpu` on the autoscale pool; looks like duplicates across regions. starting a follow-up for remediation ownership and timeline. short goal: reduce paging noise and avoid missing real incidents.

sam: thanks — quick sweep shows 3 alerts firing for the same host within ~90s. rule is `alert_cpu_high` threshold 90%, grouping only by instance_id so each AZ duplicates.

devon: propose: dedupe by `cluster` + 60s suppression window, and bump threshold to 92% for bursty jobs. also add short suppression during deploy windows.

mia: sounds reasonable. please state concrete action items and owners so we can track.

alex: i'll take ownership of the dedupe rule change and rollout. ETA EOD Wed 2026-03-25. will open PR and include a canary rollout.

harper: i'll own threshold tuning and run a 48hr metric replay to measure false positive reduction. ETA Thu AM 2026-03-26. will add results to the doc.

sam: i'll add instrumentation: emit `deploy_id` on host metrics so we can correlate pages with deploys, then add a suppression during deploys. ETA Fri 2026-03-27.

oncall-bot: Incident bot: Incident 2026-03-24T02:14Z closed — root cause: rolling deploy + noisy probe; pages: 12, duplicates suppressed: 0 (manual).

mia: action list (copied to the shared follow-up doc):
- alex: implement dedupe grouping by `cluster` + suppression window 60s — due 2026-03-25
- harper: adjust threshold to 92% and run 48h replay; attach graphs — due 2026-03-26
- sam: instrument `deploy_id` and add deploy suppression policy — due 2026-03-27
- devon: update runbook with spike patterns, add an escalation checkbox, and document rollback signals — due 2026-03-26

alex: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/p/infra-alerts/merge/42 — includes unit tests for grouping and a staged rollout plan. rolling out to staging now :rocket:.

sam: i'll watch the first 2 hours of staging rollout and post observations in this thread. if we see regressions we'll rollback the grouping change.

mia: great. i'll add these as action items in the postmortem tracker and create calendar reminders for owners. reconvene Fri standup to verify noise reduction. ping here for any date changes.

harper: noted — replay started, will attach dashboard snapshots once complete.

sam: quick note — if anyone wants to test with synthetic spikes, i can spin up a test job. ping me.

mia: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick ownership. :thumbsup:
